title: Filesystem
description: Read-only document source on a filesystem. Adapter local: a directory of a mount in the application container, below one of the allowed directories (DOCUMENT_SOURCE_LOCAL_ROOTS). Sync definitions select files below the root with include and exclude globs.

filesystem.description: Identifier flag of the filesystem connection type

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: Storage adapter: local (a directory of a mount in the application container)

root.title: Root
root.description: Root directory of the source; sync definitions select files below it. Adapter local: an absolute path that must lie within one of the allowed directories (DOCUMENT_SOURCE_LOCAL_ROOTS), e.g. /mnt/uploads/customer/project; no '..' segments, no backslashes
